headline: Saints putting RB Travis Etienne (hamstring) on IR
summary: The Saints are placing running back Travis Etienne on injured reserve, which will sideline him for at least the next four games.

headline: 49ers sign WR Brandin Cooks to active roster
summary: The 49ers signed wide receiver Brandin Cooks to the active roster from the practice squad, the team announced Thursday.

headline: Chargers' Mike McDaniel takes blame for team's offensive struggles
